title: Chris Evans & Ana de Armas Answer the Web's Most Searched Questions | WIRED

meta.description:
'Ghosted' stars Chris Evans and Ana de Armas take the WIRED Autocomplete Interview and answer the internet's most searched questions about themselves. Is Chris Evans's beard real? Is Ana de Armas a Bond girl? How did Chris meet Scarlett Johansson? Is Ana in Blade Runner? How did Chris get the Captain America role? Will Ana be the next Wonder Woman?  Chris and Ana answer all these questions and much more!

'Ghosted' premieres on Apple TV+ on April 21st
